what: Expanding ring that shoves coordinates outward and adds heat.
how: Ring radius grows over 0.9s; displacement 0.18, heat 0.55.

what: Places N items evenly around a centre without geometry data (districts around their city) using a sunflower spiral.
how: districtSpots(n,R): r = R*sqrt((i+.6)/n), a = i*2.39996 rad; dx=r*cos a, dy=r*sin a.

name_en: Exactly two drifting diagonal background lines
what: Signature motif: two translucent curved diagonal lines behind everything that drift continuously and never stop; never three.
how: for k in 0..1: ox=sin(phase*.20+k*2.3)*0.035w, oy=cos(phase*.16+k)*0.02h; quadratic curve from (-.2w+k*.63w, .93h) via (.30w+k*.41w, .43h) to (.65w+k*.5w, -.10h); stroke line colour 50% alpha, width 1.6*scale.

what: Smooth union, subtraction and intersection with a blend radius k in metres; colours blend with the same weights.
how: Pass {op:'add'|'sub'|'and', k, color} to any sculpt primitive.
params: k e.g. .012 m smooth union; sub with color tints the carved cavity (tested: tint red 1.0, plain side 0)

name_ar: نحت بدوال المسافة إلى مجسم مغلق
what: Characters and objects are sculpted from signed-distance primitives (sphere, box, smooth union, subtract with tint) and meshed with surface nets into closed, accurate geometry in the browser or Node.
how: S.sculpt().sphere(c, r).sphere(c2, r2, {k}).box(c, size, round).sphere(c, r, {op:'sub', k, color}).mesh({cells}); coarse-to-fine evaluation skips empty space.
params: tests: sphere volume ±2%, area ±3%, radius error <1e-3, 0 open edges; evals <60% of full grid; smooth-union gap <−0.005

what: Parses M L H V C S Q T A Z (absolute and relative, smooth reflections, glued arc flags) into polygons, with arcs converted by the SVG centre-parameterisation.
how: render.path('M ... Z', n=14) returns one polygon per subpath; _arc samples max(4, |dt|/2pi*64) points.

what: Rings, letters with counters and logo cut-outs: subpaths bridged to one anchor so even-odd filling cancels the bridges, or explicit Hole polygons that erase.
how: render.compound(polys); render.Hole([...]) drawn after the shape it cuts; to_python._bridge for Pillow programs.

what: One SVG shape becomes another by resampling both paths to N points and interpolating; seek-safe.
how: MOTION.morphPath(tl, pathEl, fromD, toD, at, {points, dur, ease, open}).
params: N=120 points, dur 0.66 s, ease E.inOut

what: Three bars become an X: top and bottom rotate opposite 45 degrees while the middle collapses.
how: Framer Motion or CSS transitions on three spans.

what: Move a dot, icon or cursor along an arbitrary curve, e.g. a slider following a growth curve or a plane on a route.
how: GSAP MotionPathPlugin {motionPath:{path:'M ... C ...'}} or own sampler using SVGPathElement.getPointAtLength().

name_en: Floating ambient shapes and scroll hint
what: Continuous decorative drift uses CSS keyframes with different periods so shapes never move in lockstep; a small bouncing chevron hints at more content.
how: @keyframes with translate/rotate, ease-in-out infinite; chevron translateY bounce.
params: periods 10s/12s/16s; drift 12-30px, rotate 5-8deg; chevron 8px every 2s (16px+ anxious, 4px invisible)

what: Move labels or words along a curve.
how: GSAP MotionPathPlugin path 'M..C..'; or SVG <textPath> (Arabic shapes fine in textPath in Chromium).

what: Six 270-degree arcs orbit a centre point at varying distance, alternating teal and lime, with pulsing opacity and gentle whole-group sway.
how: translate(w*.5,h*.34), rotate(sin(phase*.31)*.12); arc k: angle=phase*.5+k*PI/3, dist=w*(.15+.055 sin), radius w*(.04+.016 sin), sweep 1.5*PI, stroke #89d6ce/#d5f375, alpha .24+.25*sin^2, width max(2, .007w).

what: A breathing lime ring at the orbit centre made of a filled disc with a dark inner disc.
how: r=w*(.12+.025*sin(phase*1.25)); fill #c9f96d at r, then #0a1724 at 0.58r.

what: Three coloured sine waves cross the lower half and grow in amplitude as the scene progresses, standing in for 'hand-drawn infographic' lines.
how: For line 0..2: y=h*(.55+.07*line)+sin(x/w*3PI+phase*2+line*1.9)*(10+12p), step 4 px, colours #d3f66a #6ad8d1 #e995ff, alpha .42, width max(2,.004w).
params: 3 waves; 1.5 cycles across width; amplitude 10→22 px

what: Large soft tinted ellipse bleeding off the top-right corner as part of the environment.
how: ellipse centre (.93w,.14h), radii .35w x .13h, rotation PI/5, shape colour, alpha .65.

what: Hand-coded Canvas path icons usable as hero objects: eye, brain, wallet, money, screen, hourglass, lightbulb, rocket, clock, cursor, chart, stairs, domino, book, people, chess, plus a default star-asterisk.
how: icon(ctx, name, r, accent, ink) with round joins, stroke width .08r; select via scene.hero.

what: Thin accent-coloured ellipse orbiting around the hero, slowly tilting.
how: ellipse (.5w,.405h) radii .283w x .157h, rotation sin(phase*.1)*.12, stroke 2.5*scale accent.

what: Small accent starburst near top right that spins continuously.
how: translate(.82w,.273h), rotate(phase*.21), 4 spokes from 10 to 24 scale-px.

what: Morphs one SVG path into another by resampling both to N points and interpolating; no plugin needed.
how: MOTION.morphPath(tl, pathEl, fromD, toD, at, {points, dur, ease, open}).
params: N=120 points; dur 0.66 s; ease E.inOut; closes with Z unless open

what: Catmull-Rom TubeGeometry for mouths, whiskers, cables.
how: K3S.tube(points, r, color, {segments}).

what: Three concentric tilted ellipse outlines that rotate slowly around the glow centre for an orbital, 'study' feel.
how: ctx.rotate(t·0.1); ellipse radii r·(0.66+i·0.18) by r·(0.2+i·0.11), tilt 0.3+i·0.65 rad; line width 0.002·min(w,h).

name_en: Shape layers: circle and rounded bar
what: Animated accent shapes over scenes: a filled circle, or a rounded rectangle bar used as an underline/accent.
how: overlay.type='shape', shape 'circle' (arc radius size/2) or 'rectangle' (roundRect width size, height 0.24·size, radius max(2, 0.06·size)).
params: default size 16%, colour #52dbc6 (initial bar #55dbc4 at y 72%)

what: Characters and props as a list of soft primitives blended with smooth union/subtraction/intersection, meshed into a watertight geometry with vertex colours; no modelling package.
how: K3S.sculpt().ellipsoid(c,r,{k,color,op,rot}).sphere().capsule(a,b,r1,r2).box(c,h,round).torus(c,R,r).paint(c,r,colour,{soft}); geo = S.mesh({cells:120}).
params: ops add/sub/and; k blend radius in metres (10-30 mm for plush); 136-cell body ~1.5 s, bunny 274k triangles ~4 s

what: A picture is an ordered program of Steps made of vector shapes, gradients, light and particles, re-rendered at any size on a 1200x800 sheet.
how: def build(): return [Step(name, [ops...], order, origin=...)] ; shapes rect, ellipse(cx,cy,rx,ry,rot), poly, path('M..C..A..Z'), compound/Hole, tube(spine, radii), dots, stroke(polys,width), catmull, translate, union.

what: Turns a few control points into a smooth curve through them, open or closed; the base for tubes, whale profiles and organic outlines.
how: render.catmull(points, n=10, closed=False).

name_en: Variable-radius tube (limbs, tails, horns, flames, hair)
what: Builds an organic stroke along a smooth spine with a radius at each spine point, as a union of quads and discs so tight bends never punch holes.
how: render.tube(spine, radii, n=8); radii interpolated along catmull samples.
params: discs every n//2 samples where r>0.6

what: Converts polylines into filled outlines of a given width with round caps/joins (quads plus discs) — used for rain, pleats, mouth lines and SVG strokes.
how: render.stroke(polys, width, closed=False).

name_en: Basic shape kit (rect, ellipse with rotation, poly, dots, translate, union)
what: Minimal vector primitives in scene units that return polygon lists and compose by union.
how: rect(x,y,w,h); ellipse(cx,cy,rx,ry,rot,n=48); poly(pts); dots([(x,y,r)]); translate(shape,dx,dy); union(*shapes).

what: Generates layered mountain silhouettes by recursive midpoint displacement with optional carved peaks, filled down to the sheet bottom.
how: scenes/dragon_girl.ridge(seed, base, amp, rough=0.55, peaks=[(x, height, width)]); importable by other scenes.
params: 7 subdivision rounds; amplitude x rough per round

what: Impact squash then spring recovery.
how: Canvas ctx.scale(1+s·0.3, 1−s·0.3) around contact; s from KOSIF.window01(t,hit,hit+0.08,0.02,0.06).

what: Two squares at 0/45° + circle (a khatam-like rosette) drawn on during instrumental interludes, rotating 9°/s and breathing on the beat.
how: V.interludes [{t, end}].

what: Move an element along an SVG path with auto-rotation to the path tangent (planes, arrows, comets).
how: gsap.registerPlugin(MotionPathPlugin); tl.to(el,{motionPath:{path:'#route', align:'#route', autoRotate:true}, duration:2, ease:'power1.inOut'}). Pair with a stroke-dashoffset draw of the same path.

what: Sphere vertices pushed along normals by animated noise for a living blob.
how: Vertex shader: disp=pnoise(position*1.5+time*0.5); newPos=position+normal*disp*intensity.

what: Sphere displaced along normals by time-driven Perlin noise for a living blob.
how: three.js ShaderMaterial; displacement = pnoise(position*1.5 + t*0.5)*intensity.

what: A 0.6-1 s burst of 14 radial lines and an expanding ring for emphasis.
how: TEMPLATES.shapes: lines from r0=m(0.1+0.25k) to r1=m(0.16+0.42k)*jitter, alternating accent/primary, ring radius 0.42m*k, fades over the second half.

what: Timed overlays that spring in with a slight wobble: emoji, accent text pills, or image/SVG stickers.
how: drawOverlays(): spring(z .4, w 17) scale, rotate sin(3l)*0.03, 0.2 s fade-out; positions top 30%, center 47%, bottom 64%, corner (78%,16%); emoji 17% m; text Lalezar 6.5% m on accent pill; stickers 46% m (26% in corner) with white card or SVG shadow.
